clue.text: Just the right thing to take!

definitions.meaning: fitting or suitable for the occasion, as an adjective
to seize something for one's own use, as a verb

explanation.surface: An exclamation praising a perfect item to carry along.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective the word means suitable; as a verb it means to seize for oneself, often without permission.

clue.text: Bill and Edward got out of bed and behaved badly

parts.note: AC, short for account, is a bill
Ted is a familiar form of the name Edward
someone who has got out of bed is up

explanation.surface: Two men named Bill and Edward rose late and misbehaved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' looks like a man's name beside Edward, but it is an account, AC.
explanation.definitionFit: To act up is an idiom for misbehaving or playing up.

clue.text: Sounds like a bit of tranquillity

indicators.note: signals that the word for a bit is to be heard, not spelt

parts.note: a piece is a bit of something

explanation.surface: A small amount of calm is described as audible.
explanation.definitionFit: Peace and tranquillity are synonyms for a state of calm.

clue.text: Weighs down with work on printing machinery

parts.note: OP, short for opus, is a musical work
printing presses are the machines that print

explanation.surface: Someone is burdened by labour on the printing machines.
explanation.definitionFit: To oppress is to burden or crush, as a weight bears down on someone.

clue.text: Space to tie up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for tie is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to moor a boat is to tie it up

explanation.surface: A place where one can fasten something.
explanation.definitionFit: Room means space or capacity, as in room to move.

clue.text: Take away something that isn't concrete

definitions.meaning: to remove or extract, as a verb
a notion with no physical form, as a noun

explanation.surface: Remove something that is intangible.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means to extract or remove; as a noun it is an idea with no physical existence.

clue.text: Doesn't begin to get geared to having sound detectors

indicators.note: the word geared loses its opening letter

explanation.surface: Someone fails to start getting ready for listening equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: Ears detect sound, so something eared has those hearing organs.

clue.text: Mark has 100 of these

parts.note: Mark is not a person but the old German currency, divided into a hundred small coins

explanation.surface: A man called Mark owns a hundred items.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mark' seems to be a name; it is the Deutschmark, the German currency before the euro.
explanation.definitionFit: The small coin was one hundredth of the old German currency unit.

clue.text: Complete picture, or just a general survey

definitions.meaning: a whole view of something taken in at once

explanation.surface: A whole image, or merely a broad examination.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a view of the whole scene and a summary that covers matters broadly.

clue.text: Stirring articles are written about soapstone!

indicators.note: the letters of soapstone are moved about to be rewritten in a new order

explanation.surface: Spoons for stirring are said to be described in a piece about a soft mineral.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stirring' suggests exciting writing, but it means stirring tea.
explanation.definitionFit: Small spoons are utensils used for stirring drinks.

clue.text: Exciting start made by five in French street to produce theatrical work

indicators.note: the letters are placed inside the French word for street

parts.note: rue is French for street

indicators.note: the start of Exciting is its opening letter

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: A thrilling opening by five performers on a Paris street gives a stage show.
explanation.definitionFit: A light theatrical entertainment of sketches, songs and dances.

clue.text: Finishes the Spanish fuel

parts.note: dies means finishes or comes to an end
el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: A Spaniard comes to the end of the fuel.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy oil used to power certain engines.

clue.text: Cooking utensil found on American football field

definitions.meaning: a grating of metal bars for grilling food
the pitch marked with parallel lines

explanation.surface: A kitchen tool turns up on a football pitch in America.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a metal grill for cooking and, from its parallel markings, a pitch in American football.

clue.text: Commendation produced quiet increase in salary

parts.note: P stands for piano, the musical term for quiet
a raise is a pay rise

explanation.surface: Praise from the boss came with a modest pay rise.
explanation.definitionFit: Commendation and acclaim are synonyms for expressed approval.

clue.text: A protein which could be a deadly poison

indicators.note: the letters of a protein could be rearranged into another word

explanation.surface: A protein that might turn out to be lethal.
explanation.definitionFit: The alkaloid from deadly nightshade is a highly toxic substance.

clue.text: In a hurry to make some notes about a bird

indicators.note: the word for making notes goes round the bird

parts.note: to sing is to produce musical notes
a coot is a water bird

explanation.surface: Rushing to jot down some details about a bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'notes' suggests writing, but it means musical notes.
explanation.definitionFit: Scooting means dashing off quickly.

clue.text: Muddled alto didn't start aria or perform in the style of an actor

definitions.text: in the style of an actor

indicators.note: the letters are confused into a new arrangement
the word aria loses its opening letter

explanation.surface: A confused alto sings an aria without its opening, or acts theatrically.
explanation.walkthrough: 'didn't start' removes the A from ARIA to give RIA, which joins ALTO and OR in the shuffle. 'perform' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to an orator, someone who speaks with rhetorical flourish like a stage performer.

clue.text: They gave a skilful performance, but caused our visit to be rescheduled

indicators.note: the letters of our visit are rearranged like a timetable

explanation.surface: Star performers forced a planned trip to be moved.
explanation.definitionFit: Virtuosos are highly skilled performers, especially musicians.

clue.text: Terrible actors took 99 attempts at the word puzzle

indicators.note: terrible actors are bad, so their letters are rearranged

parts.note: in Roman numerals I before C makes ninety-nine

explanation.surface: Bad performers needed ninety-nine tries to solve a puzzle.
explanation.walkthrough: IC is one less than C (100), so it is 99 in Roman numerals.
explanation.definitionFit: A poem or puzzle where the initial letters of lines spell a word.

clue.text: Dwelling permanently

parts.note: living somewhere for good, and also lasting for ever

explanation.surface: Living somewhere for good.
explanation.definitionFit: To abide is to dwell, and something abiding endures.

clue.text: Listen in on small insect

definitions.meaning: a creature with pincers on its tail

explanation.surface: Eavesdropping on a tiny bug.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a pincered insect and, as a verb, means to eavesdrop.

clue.text: Strange shaped stones

indicators.note: the letters of strange are shaped into a new form

explanation.surface: Oddly formed rocks.
explanation.definitionFit: Red semi-precious gemstones.

clue.text: Puts in a thousand vegetables perhaps

parts.note: I is one, which is a
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
vegetables are an example of plants

explanation.surface: A gardener sets out a thousand vegetables.
explanation.definitionFit: To implant is to insert or embed something.

clue.text: Pop back for the painting, separately

indicators.note: the word for pop is read backwards

parts.note: pa and pop are both words for father
painting is a form of art

explanation.surface: Dad returns to collect the picture on his own.
explanation.definitionFit: Apart means separately or at a distance.

clue.text: Disorganised engineer involved in poor work, but he does produce a barrel

indicators.note: the engineer and the word poor, taken together, are thrown into disorder
involved suggests the engineer is tangled up together with the word poor before the jumble

parts.note: CE stands for civil engineer

explanation.surface: A muddled engineer doing bad work still turns out a cask.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved in' and 'work' just link the engineer with 'poor': CE and POOR are shuffled together.
explanation.definitionFit: A barrel-maker builds casks from wooden staves.

clue.text: Fabric which might cause irritation

explanation.surface: A cloth that might make the skin itch.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a ribbed cotton cloth and a fit of resentment.

clue.text: Clever fellow and a soldier are both wise men

parts.note: an MA is a Master of Arts, a learned person
a GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A scholar and a soldier are both sages.
explanation.walkthrough: The Magi are the three wise men of the Nativity story.
explanation.definitionFit: The Magi were the learned men from the East who visited the infant Jesus.

clue.text: Aegean islands are first class — no one returns

indicators.note: the whole string of letters is turned back to front

parts.note: A1 means first class, written AI
taken as written
I is one in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Greek islands are top-rate, but nobody goes back.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Greek region on the Aegean coast and its islands.

clue.text: Harem slave found squalid mess, and opposite extremes

indicators.note: the letters are made into a mess, rearranged
the extremes of opposite are its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A harem slave discovered a filthy mess at both ends.
explanation.definitionFit: A concubine or female slave in a Turkish seraglio.

clue.text: Silvestrian arrangement is of little importance

indicators.note: the letters of silvestrian are put in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A woodland arrangement matters little.
explanation.definitionFit: Triviality is the quality of mattering little.
